def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """
    Greedy placement: sort models by r_j/s_j descending, then place each on
    the GPU whose *resulting* KVPR after placement is lowest (tie-break on
    most remaining memory), among GPUs with enough free memory.

    Args:
        gpu_num: Number of GPUs
        models: List of models to place

    Returns:
        A placement of models to GPUs
    """

    # Greedy KVPR-minimizing placement based on Algorithm 1 (without τ check)
    # 1) Sort models by r_j / s_j in descending order
    sorted_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True)

    # 2) Initialize per-GPU states
    placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
    shared_kv = [GPU_MEM_SIZE for _ in range(gpu_num)]  # remaining memory per GPU
    weighted_req_rate = [0.0 for _ in range(gpu_num)]   # sum of r_j / s_j per GPU

    # 3) Assign each model to the GPU minimizing the *resulting* KVPR after placement
    for model in sorted_models:
        best_idx = None
        best_key = None

        for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
            if model.model_size <= shared_kv[gpu_id] and shared_kv[gpu_id] > 0:
                new_w = weighted_req_rate[gpu_id] + model.req_rate / model.slo
                new_f = shared_kv[gpu_id] - model.model_size
                # key: resulting KVPR, tie-break on most remaining memory
                key = (new_w / new_f, -new_f)
                if best_key is None or key < best_key:
                    best_key = key
                    best_idx = gpu_id

        # Failure: if no GPU can fit, raise an error instead of overcommitting
        if best_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unable to place model of size {model.model_size} GB on any GPU. "
                f"Remaining per-GPU memory: {shared_kv}"
            )

        placement[best_idx].append(model)
        weighted_req_rate[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        shared_kv[best_idx] -= model.model_size

    return placement

    placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num          # remaining memory per GPU
    weight = [0.0] * gpu_num                 # sum of r_j / s_j per GPU

    for model in sorted_models:
        best_idx, best_ratio = None, float('inf')

            if model.model_size <= free[g] and free[g] > 0:
                ratio = weight[g] / free[g]
                if ratio < best_ratio:
                    best_ratio, best_idx = ratio, g
        if best_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unable to place model of size {model.model_size} GB on any GPU."
            )
        placement[best_idx].append(model)
        weight[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        free[best_idx] -= model.model_size

    # Local search: move a model off the worst GPU when it lowers the max KVPR
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        worst = max(range(gpu_num), key=lambda g: kvpr(weight[g], free[g]))
        worst_val = kvpr(weight[worst], free[worst])
        for m in list(placement[worst]):

                    improved = True
